tracedAction: Learning to Earning and shelter kitchens with WFP support. Supports relief delivery through supplies, services, programs, or partner assistance. WFP: cash to 183,000 people within 24 hours of the Beirut displacement of 6 March; 226,000 total reached with emergency cash; basic-needs cash to 26,700 Syrian refugee households; 12.4M hot and cold meals distributed by the Food Security sector since March 2026 and 73,000 ready-to-eat kits; pipeline breaks expected from July on funding gaps.
